sentences.text: Shri Sushant Tiwari- Government Advocate for the State.
The registry has raised an objection that this miscellaneous petition is not maintainable in fact miscellaneous appeal should have been filed.
Learned counsel for the petitioners prays for and is granted time to move an application for conversion of this miscellaneous petition into miscellaneous appeal.

It is further observed that as per Section 76 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, there is a provision of depositing the penalty, which has not been deposited by the petitioners as submitted by him.

(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE Pj'S/-
